messages:
ravi: quick note: hit duplicate task creation in sampleapp when resume got a 429 during token refresh. root ts 1778001234

tia: paste minimal repro? short logs help.

ravi: repro: start streaming POST /tasks, expire token mid-stream, refresh, resume gets 429, SDK retries immediately and server records two tasks. Logs show two POSTs within 200ms with same body.

leo: parity gap: python helper adds Idempotency-Key; node runtime does not. Also node backoff = fixed, no jitter.

tia: short fixes: auto-add Idempotency-Key for create endpoints when resumable_stream or retry_on_429 enabled; add small full-jitter to backoff (initial 10-100ms; multiplier backoff thereafter). Make derivation deterministic (session_id+payload hash) but opt-outtable.

ci-bot: e2e: sampleapp/retries/token-rotate -> FAIL duplicate task detected. artifact ci/9012

ravi: I'll add failing e2e and a tiny doc note. tia/leo to take SDK PRs.

tia: will open Node PR today with enable_auto_idempotency=true, jitter=full, and config flags. will add tests.

leo: server recommendation: honor Idempotency-Key + fingerprint; return existing resource if duplicate. but SDK fixes first.

tia: TL;DR: auto idempotency on resume + full jitter + sampleapp e2e guard.
